model: Disney Princess Light Up Kick Scooter
description:
The Disney Princess scooter features vibrant LED lights along the deck and wheels, bringing a dazzling glow to every ride. With enchanting princess graphics, your little one will feel like royalty on their magical adventures.
The non-slip deck keeps little feet securely in place, ensuring safe and confident rides. Adorned with vibrant Disney Princess graphics, it’s as functional as it is enchanting for every adventure.
The lightweight frame folds easily for quick storage and transport, making it perfect for on-the-go adventures. Whether heading to the park or packing for a trip, this scooter is as portable as it is fun.

components.description: Rear fender foot brake provides solid control
